title: A Classification of Fractal Squares
summary: Let $λ_K:\bbR^2\rightarrow\{0,1,\ldots\}\cup\{\infty\}$ be the lambda function of a planar comapctum $K$, as defined in MR4488162. It is known that a planar continuum is locally connected if and only if its lambda function vanishes everywhere, or equivalently, $λ_K(K)=\{0\}$. In this article we show that every fractal square $K$ satisfies $λ_K(K)\subset\{0,1\}$ and find criterions to classify when $λ_K(K)$ equals $\{0\}$, $\{1\}$ or $\{0,1\}$.
